bias_disclosure.permitted_use: Mechanism diagnosis and selection of a materially distinct future hypothesis only.
bias_disclosure.prohibited_use: No threshold, subgroup, exit, or parameter discovered here may be presented as independent validation or promoted into V58.

frozen_scope.trades: Standalone candidate arm, nominal friction scenario, all development, validation, and pseudo-holdout completed trades.
frozen_scope.path_source: Registered BTC one-minute bars; MFE and MAE stop at the actual modeled exit; fixed-horizon returns continue from entry regardless of earlier modeled exit and are labeled forward diagnostics.
frozen_scope.signal_source: Exact frozen completed-hour and completed-fifteen-minute diagnostics from V58_BTC_15M_TREND_PULLBACK_REACCELERATION_LONG_V1.

frozen_measurements: gross PnL, fees, funding, net PnL, win/loss counts, mean net win/loss, and after-cost break-even win rate
actual holding time and actual-exit MFE/MAE
fixed 15-, 60-, and 240-minute close returns from entry
hourly EMA21/EMA55 gap, signal close distance above EMA21, and breakout excess above the prior four-bar high
pullback-arm age and pullback low distance from EMA21
stop-path counts reaching at least 20 and 40 bps MFE before the modeled stop
the same descriptive results by exit reason and chronological partition
interpretation_rules: Negative aggregate gross PnL falsifies a costs-only diagnosis.
A win rate below the realized after-cost break-even rate falsifies adequacy of the frozen entry/payoff combination.
Consistently adverse early forward returns among stopped trades support false-reacceleration timing but do not validate a filter.
Any apparently favorable subgroup remains exploratory because all partitions and preliminary attribution were already opened.
The rejected candidate remains rejected regardless of this attribution.
failure_conditions: Any registered source hash or byte count differs.
The selected standalone nominal candidate trade count is not exactly 147.
A signal timestamp cannot join exactly to the causal fifteen-minute diagnostic that emitted it.
A fixed horizon or actual-exit path lacks registered minute coverage.
The report claims execution authority, live promotion, independent validation, or a selected profitable subgroup.
